Frontend Developer.description: Builds responsive, accessible browser user interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, REST APIs, Git, and automated UI testing.

Backend Developer.description: Designs server-side web APIs, relational databases, testing, and containerized deployments using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, SQL, Git, and Docker.

Full Stack Developer.description: Builds end-to-end full-stack web applications spanning client-side web UIs, server-side Node.js REST APIs, relational SQL databases, Git workflows, automated testing, and Dockerized deployments.

Python Developer.description: Develops clean Python applications, REST APIs, database integrations, automated pytest suites, and containerized services.

Data Analyst.description: Analyzes tabular datasets, writes SQL queries, performs exploratory data analysis and statistics, and creates charts with Python and Pandas.

Data Scientist.description: Combines SQL, Python, statistics, exploratory data analysis, visualization, and scikit-learn machine learning models to analyze data.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Builds, evaluates, and deploys production machine learning and NLP systems using Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch, FastAPI, testing, and Docker.
